description: This file defines the ConvertBinary class, which provides static methods for converting binary numbers to decimal, hexadecimal, and octal representations, including handling of two's complement negative binary numbers. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine.

classes.name: ConvertBinary
classes.description: A class providing static methods to convert binary strings to decimal, hexadecimal, and octal formats, with support for two's complement negative numbers.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a binary string to its decimal equivalent, handling two's complement for negative numbers.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a binary string to its hexadecimal equivalent, with optional zero-padding.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a binary string to its octal equivalent, handling two's complement for negatives.

methods.name: validateBinary
methods.description: Validates that the input binary string has up to 10 bits and contains only 0s and 1s.
